T: The Trainman runs on time. So does dinner.
D: As the machines close in on Zion, Neo sets out on a last journey to end the war.
P: Serve the snacks when Neo wakes up alone on the platform at Mobil Avenue.
S: something warm for the wait on the empty platform

Mix 500g pork sausage mince with a grated onion, 1 tsp crushed fennel seeds, 1 tsp dried thyme, 30g breadcrumbs and pepper. Halve 2 sheets of puff pastry, lay a log of filling along each strip, roll and seal. Brush with beaten egg, scatter with sesame, cut each into 6, chill for 15 minutes and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve with tomato sauce.
dressed for the Merovingian's club in red and black

Boil 6 eggs for 10 minutes, cool in iced water for 10 minutes, peel and halve. Mash the yolks with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tsp dijon, 1 tsp lemon juice, a pinch of cayenne and salt, and pipe back into the whites. Dust with smoked paprika, black sesame seeds and chopped chives.
M: Trainman's dining car chicken and leek pie
the only hot meal running between two worlds

Brown 800g diced chicken thigh in oil, then soften 2 sliced leeks and 2 garlic cloves in 30g butter. Stir in 2 tbsp flour, then 400ml chicken stock, 150ml cream, 1 tbsp dijon and a tsp of thyme, return the chicken and simmer for 20 minutes. Cool, spoon into a pie dish, top with puff pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 30 minutes.
800g chicken thigh fillets, cut into chunks@Meat
Rama-Kandra, the program who broke every rule to get his daughter out

Golden red lentil and spinach dal with a sizzling cumin and chilli tarka, basmati rice and naan. Simmer the rinsed lentils with the turmeric and 1 litre of water for 20 minutes until soft, stirring now and then. Fry the chopped onion, garlic and ginger in half the ghee for 8 minutes, add the tomatoes and stir into the lentils with the spinach. Simmer the rice with 600ml water, covered, for 12 minutes, then rest for 5. Sizzle the cumin seeds and chillies in the rest of the ghee for 1 minute and pour over the dal. Warm the naan and serve with the dal, rice, lemon and coriander.
W: warm and heavy, for the long ride out of Mobil Avenue

Spoon 4 tbsp golden syrup into a buttered 1.2 litre basin. Cream 125g butter with 125g caster sugar, beat in 2 eggs, fold in 175g self-raising flour, a lemon's zest and 3 tbsp milk, and spoon on top. Cover with pleated baking paper and foil, tie and steam for 90 minutes. Heat 400ml milk with vanilla, pour onto 4 yolks whisked with 50g sugar and 1 tbsp cornflour and stir over low heat until thick. Turn out the pudding and serve with the custard.
125g butter, softened, plus extra for the basin@Dairy
400ml full cream milk, for the custard@Dairy
K: orange and red, the way a little girl would paint the sky

Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Pour in 500ml chilled orange juice and 400ml soda water, then slowly pour 20ml grenadine down the side of each glass so it sinks. Squeeze in a little lime and finish with an orange slice.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C, line a tray and thaw the pastry.
Mix the sausage mince with the onion, fennel, thyme, breadcrumbs and pepper.
Cut each pastry sheet in half, lay a log of filling along each strip, roll up and seal the seam.
Brush with the egg, scatter with sesame, cut each roll into 6 and slash the tops.
Chill on the tray for 15 minutes.
Bake for 25 minutes until puffed, golden and cooked through.
Serve hot with the tomato sauce.

dishes.n: Trainman's dining car chicken and leek pie
dishes.make_ahead: Make and chill the filling up to 2 days ahead; top with pastry and bake on the night

ingredients.item: chicken thigh fillets, cut into chunks

steps.text: Season the chicken and brown it in the oil in a wide pan in batches. Set aside.
Melt the butter in the pan and soften the leeks and garlic for 8 minutes.
Stir in the flour for a minute, then the stock, cream, mustard and thyme. Return the chicken and simmer for 20 minutes until thick.
Cool the filling for 20 minutes.
Heat the oven to 200C. Spoon the filling into a pie dish, top with the pastry, crimp the edges, brush with egg and cut 2 vents.
Bake for 30 minutes until puffed and deep golden.
Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

dishes.make_ahead: Steam up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled in the basin and resteam for 30 minutes; make the custard on the night

ingredients.item: butter, softened, plus extra for the basin
full cream milk, for the custard

steps.text: Butter a 1.2 litre pudding basin and spoon the golden syrup into the base.
Cream the butter and sugar until pale.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, then fold in the flour, lemon zest and milk.
Spoon into the basin, cover with pleated buttered baking paper and foil and tie with string.
Stand on a trivet in a large pot with boiling water halfway up the basin, cover and steam for 90 minutes, topping up the water.
For the custard, heat the milk and vanilla. Whisk the yolks, sugar and cornflour, pour on the hot milk, return to the pan and stir over low heat until thick.
Rest the pudding for 5 minutes, turn out onto a plate and serve with the custard.
